رَمْضَآءُ , a subst., (TA,) [or rather an epithet in which the quality of a subst. predominates,] Ground or land, (S, K,) or stones, (A, Mgh, Msb,) or sand, (IAth,) vehemently hot: (K:) or vehemently heated by the sun: (S, A, Mgh, Msb:) or vehemently hot and burning. (IAth.) [See also رَمِضٌ.] ―
-b2- It is also syn. with رَمَضٌ as expl. above: see the latter word. (Mgh, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
